sourceText: Verify whether the two Codex-reported review-run metadataRoot defects exist (production captureReviewRunSnapshot signing from signedWorkspaceRoot, and consumer freshness recompute passing signedRoot as metadataRoot), then run the full Story lifecycle including a red test and spike to nail the reproduction, and fix through to completion.
normalizedOutcome: In a wrapper-root project with a custom storyDir, a metadata-only commit to that storyDir no longer false-stales reviewer runs; review-run material/story hash semantics match the DONE gate; plain-repo/default-storyDir behavior stays byte-identical; lattice validate is all green.
acceptanceClaim: A durable regression test (wrapper-root + custom storyDir + metadata-only commit) passes and lattice validate is all green after threading metadataRoot through captureReviewRunSnapshot/diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot and the two consumer freshness checks.
